sloka: रथ वाजि गजानाम् च भूषितानाम् च रक्षसाम् ।सम्भ्रमो रक्षसामेष हृषितानाम् तरस्विनाम् ।। ६-३३-२६
transliteration: ratha vāji gajānām ca bhūṣitānām ca rakṣasām ।sambhramo rakṣasāmeṣa hṛṣitānām tarasvinām ।। 6-33-26

translations.english: "Look at the sheen of weapons, the leather shields, spreading forth different pleasing colours, the brightness of which resembles the burning of forest fire arisen and spread in summer. And here are chariots, horses and elephants decked with ornaments following Ravana, as well as the powerful Rakshasa army full of joy."
translations.hindi: तथा रथों, घोड़ों हाथियों और रावण के सुसज्जित राक्षस योद्धाओं की सजावट से, रंग बिरंगी चमक या प्रभा वैसी ही निकल रही है
